debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic bullish cross, supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud with extreme fear (26/100) create a contrarian oversold bounce setup at support (56.22).
debate.key_bear_argument: Death cross, bearish MACD, price below all key moving averages, no volume confirmation (OBV flat), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and earnings risk in 56 days create overwhelming structural and macro headwinds that overshadow technical oversold signals.
